This plugin is built against the InMusic MPC Plugin Builder SDK framework.
SDK: https://github.com/inmusic-software/mpc-plugin-builder-sdk
Build source revision used for V0.4: febd2ca5bd9eb16c4a412837196e145566bc981b
License: MIT. The framework is supplied by the external SDK and is not copied
into this repository. Obtain that exact revision to reproduce the build.

The bundled V0.2 analyzer service includes PFFFT, whose source and license are
retained in the main repository at src/third_party/pffft/. A copy of its
license is included beside the packaged service executable.

LED artwork in Plugin Skins was generated by scripts/generate-force-rta-skin.py
using Pillow and DejaVu Sans system fonts. DejaVu fonts are distributed under
the Bitstream Vera license with DejaVu changes; the generated artwork contains
only rasterized labels and simple shapes.
